$comment: Mazda RX-7 FD3S with a GM LS1 or LS3: the hardware real builds use, researched 2026-09-29 from vendor product pages (Sikky Manufacturing, Hinson Motorsports, Wiring Specialties); every page cited is saved and quote-checked. Prices as listed on 2026-09-29 in USD; many Hinson items show 'Out of stock' and build-to-order lead times. Covered: engine mounts, transmission mounts and the PPF replacements (Sikky brace, Hinson subframe, brace and torque arm), the Sikky pan, headers, driveshafts (with the diff-flange split by factory gearbox), radiators, bumpsteer and power-steering parts, fuel lines, clutch hydraulics, T56 fitting parts, car-specific harnesses and Haltech Rebel ECU packages. Generic LS hardware (GM PCMs, T56/TR6060, clutches, universal pans) is in the common LS file. Not found: any source on hood clearance for the LS1 or LS3 intake (vendor pages are silent; the forum threads found are blocked), which factory GM pan clears, an RX-7-specific Hinson engine-mount listing, an adapter for the Mazda 5-speed, and JDM/RHD harnesses. CX Racing blocks automated reading and is not included. Merged 2026-09-29 with the hardware common to every LS swap (GM PCM, Chevrolet Performance and Holley ECU routes, standalone harnesses, GM and Tremec gearboxes, clutches, fuel regulators), which a separate research pass sourced; those parts repeat in each LS swap file until Phase 3 moves them into parts/.

notes: Two layouts: Sikky keeps the factory front subframe and suspension, pulls the engine back (firewall clearancing) and sells a PPF/diff brace; Hinson replaces the engine subframe, adds a transmission brace, torque arm and bumpsteer kit, and uses C6 Corvette pedestals with Hinson urethane mounts. Gearboxes: Sikky is designed for the LS1-style T56 (T56 Magnum too; TR6060 and CD00X brackets are listed but no driveshaft yet); Hinson for the T56 or 4L60E. The diff flange depends on the car's factory gearbox (manual 3.75 in, automatic 4.125 in). No adapter to keep the Mazda 5-speed was found. LS1 vs LS3: Sikky sells one set of mounts and one pan for both and puts the same headers in its LS1 and LS3 packages; the power-steering lines, harness and pedal differ (the LS3 harnesses use a GM drive-by-wire pedal). Hood clearance: no source found for either intake.
